name: type1-not-available-to-geojson
source: values chosen for this vector (as type1-all-not-available)
reference: Longitude 181, latitude 91, speed 1023 and course 3600 are the not-available codes (AIVDM.adoc, common navigation block); each is `absent` on its line, so the four keys are absent after decode (pack.md, Not-available codes on decode) and none reaches GeoJSON: geometry null, no course or speed_ms property, then id (ruling 4 of 0.1.1). uid is derived as text_of(ais.mmsi) (model/ais.def), so it is checked with @complete.
